objectives.description: Use Sales when the Ad Mission is buyers, checkout, or a paid offer.
objectives.recommendation: Prefer Sales for direct-response purchase missions when tracking and the landing page are ready.

objectives.description: Use Leads when the Ad Mission is qualified contacts before a sale, consultation, form submission, or follow-up.
objectives.recommendation: Prefer Leads for service businesses or sales-assisted offers where the first conversion is a contact.

objectives.description: Traffic can be useful for visits or content distribution, but it can misalign with sales missions.
objectives.recommendation: Warn when the Ad Mission is direct sales. Traffic can optimize toward cheap visits instead of buyer intent.

objectives.description: Awareness can support reach or visibility, but it is usually weak evidence for small-budget direct-response missions.
objectives.recommendation: Avoid Awareness for small-budget conversion missions unless the user explicitly accepts weak conversion signal.
